propositions: A repository-wide guard mechanism must detect and prevent reintroduction of deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary while preserving deliberately exempt frozen migration records, Jira captures, and permanent semantic carve-outs.

A count-pinned allowlist with path, integer count, and reason fields must enforce that residual vocabulary matches remain at exactly their documented frequencies, failing on mismatch, malformation, duplication, or staleness.

The three residual live-prose occurrences in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated from 'Success Criteria' to 'Acceptance Criteria' wording.

Scoped bare-token matching (SC/SCs) must be enforced only under src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md, while bare tokens outside these paths remain unexempted by design.
The guard must be integrated into the root Makefile lint target so that local make lint and CI invoke the same check deterministically.

Case-insensitive phrase matching across the repository must exclude docs/archive/**, docs/experiments/**, minified vendor bundles, and generated/cache directories, while preserving byte-identity of O-RAN-SC references.
